admission.justification: The writer's row binding and the gates' item construction promise together what neither promises alone: the row that answers the worklist answers every gate, and a gate that cannot build the worklist's item refuses instead of judging another one.

guarantee: For one leaf candidate the worklist item, the card row that binds its sources, and every gate that judges that row are the same item: an answer given to the worklist holds at the memory-quality run and at the closeout validator, and a gate that cannot build that item refuses by name instead of judging a different one.
title: A row that answers the worklist answers every gate
